description: Completes or updates progress for a company-level unified upload. Send part_etags: one ETag per segment (from each PUT response), same order as POST segments. Single-part: one ETag. Segmented: one per segment; null for not-yet-uploaded segments (partial progress). All non-null completes the upload; response includes upload_id and status (e.g. complete).

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid request body or parameters

500.description: Internal Server Error - Failed to complete upload
